description: Unlink a resource from a trail. Remove a resource from the trail. The entity itself is untouched; only the trail's link to it goes, and the release gates stop counting it.

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

id.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

name: trails_resources_remove
